meta.name: Whisky Peak
meta.description: La primera isla en el Grand Line es sorprendentemente acogedora para piratas. Pero cuando la noche cae, un complot mortal se desmaraña.

videos.title: The Town of Celebration
videos.overview: As the Straw Hat Pirates travel from Reverse Mountain to Whisky Peak, Nami adjusts to having to watch the log pose constantly. When they arrive at their destination, the townspeople greet them warmly, despite the sight of their Jolly Roger.

videos.title: The Secret Criminal Organization
videos.overview: As Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine chase after the fleeing princess Vivi, Igaram begs Zoro to save her. But just when Zoro is about to take on Vivi's assailants, an enraged Luffy confronts him under a massive misunderstanding of the swordsman's latest actions.
